articles.title: Ethereum's Vitalik Buterin is rethinking how DeFi handles market crashes
articles.snippet: In a research post published Monday, Buterin proposed creating index-tracking assets using options contracts rather than the debt-based structures that underpin much of DeFi today.

articles.title: Japan's ruling party supports crypto ETF trading, yen-based stablecoins
articles.snippet: Japan's ruling Liberal Democratic Party said the country should create a legal framework for trading crypto ETFs in a proposal to the finance minister.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: Stellar (XLM) surges 14.1% over weekend
articles.snippet: Binance Coin (BNB), up 7.9%, was also a top performer.

articles.title: Cardano Summit 2026 canceled after community votes against Foundation funding proposal
articles.snippet: The Cardano Foundation's flagship conference was scrapped after a funding proposal failed to secure the two-thirds support required under the blockchain's new governance system.

articles.title: Bitcoin, ether start June in the red while futures show taste for risk. XLM, HYPE gain
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and ether fell Monday after dropping in May, a month that usually sees them post positive returns. U.S. equity index futures rose.
